narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To demonstrate that support for Scottish independence remains a minority view among the population based on polling data.

units.meaning: The YES/support series is consistently lower than the NO/oppose series at every shared poll point.
accepted_routes: NO leads YES at every poll
units.visual_evidence_rule: Both series shown; NO marks stay above YES at every shared time point.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video show NO above YES at every poll point?

units.meaning: The highest YES relative value remains below the lowest NO relative value, showing no overlap/crossing.
accepted_routes: YES peak stays below NO trough
NO never falls to YES level
YES highest is still under NO lowest
units.visual_evidence_rule: YES peak and NO trough visible; YES stays below NO minimum.
units.reviewer_question: Must the chart show YES never reaches NO's lowest level?

units.meaning: The DON'T KNOW series is the smallest relative series at every shared poll point.
accepted_routes: DON'T KNOW is below YES and NO
DON'T KNOW is the least chosen option
DON'T KNOW remains the bottom series
units.visual_evidence_rule: DON'T KNOW marks stay below both YES and NO series.
units.reviewer_question: Should the DON'T KNOW series be included as smallest option?

units.meaning: The YES/support series fluctuates but remains in a narrow relative band over the poll points.
accepted_routes: Support is stable at a low relative level
YES fluctuates in a narrow band
units.visual_evidence_rule: YES series stays within a narrow band across all poll points.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video show YES trend stability over multiple polls?

units.meaning: The NO–YES relative gap varies, widest at earliest point and narrowest mid-series.
accepted_routes: NO lead is largest at first poll
Gap between NO and YES varies
units.visual_evidence_rule: Distance between NO and YES marks varies across poll points.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video show how the NO–YES gap changes over time?

optional_valid: DON'T KNOW is the smallest option throughout
NO–YES gap widest at earliest point and narrowest mid-series
NO series remains the highest relative series at all poll points
YES series low around 0.4256 and high around 0.5161
unsupported_to_avoid: Absolute percentages, counts, or vote shares
Claims about Scottish population or referendum outcome
Causal reasons for support or opposition
Treating relative_value as a percentage or majority threshold
notes: Table has only relative_value, so units use relative comparisons and trends. YES series stays below NO series throughout, supporting minority relative position.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
